title: Chapter 453
text:
On the spaceship, everyone started doing their own things. After two months of running around, they had already gotten used to this pace of life.

Han Xiao returned to his room alone, opened the interface, and rubbed his hands crazily.

"Four chances, four consecutive draws. Don't disappoint me again."

After failing so many times, he was already very calm. As a Mechanic, he always believed in quantity.

Beep beep beep …

Just as he was about to start the Random Reward, his communicator suddenly rang.

"Who is it?"

Han Xiao's tone was a little unhappy that the ritual was interrupted.

"It's me, Nereja. Do you still remember me?"

Looking at the Godora person on the screen, Han Xiao recognized him immediately. "Oh! You're that green … cough cough, nice to meet you. This seems to be the first time you've contacted me after what happened last time. Why are you looking for me? Do you want to hire me again? "

"No, I'm here to pass on a message." Nereja laughed heartily. "Do you know someone called Kerlodd? He's my classmate in the investigator training class. He called me a few days ago and said that his investigator account was used by someone else in another place, and the coordinates happened to be here. I mentioned you when I was chatting with him. When he heard your name, his reaction was a little … uh, a little extreme. He seems to want you to pay him back. "

Han Xiao understood. He had entered Kerlodd's ID into the system of the missing spaceship. At that time, the radiation storm had blocked the signal. After bringing the system core back to the space station, the people there would naturally look at the recording and find the operation record.

Kerlodd was the Godora investigator who was sent to investigate Blue Star and was caught by him.

Han Xiao nodded. "Oh, we're very good friends. How's that guy? Send my regards to him."

Nereja had a weird expression.

"… Are you sure we're friends? He asked me to tell you, 'Black Star, don't use my ID anymore! When are you going to pay me back the money you extorted from me? You're already a famous mercenary. Are you still stingy with a few hundred Enas? '"

"Hehe, he still likes to joke. I've been through life and death situations with him. How can you measure it with money?" Han Xiao laughed.

Back then, he had spared his life. Wasn't that a life and death friendship?

Speaking of which, Han Xiao had kept his promise and let Kerlodd go because he wanted to leave a channel to communicate with Godora. He did not expect Kerlodd to join Floating Dragon Island, but Kerlodd was still useful.

I asked Kerlodd to pay attention to the abnormality of Blue Star. I wonder if they sent anyone else to investigate. Maybe this will add a new variable to the plot of Version 2.0 … It should be a good variable.

Han Xiaoxin thought to himself.

"Alright, tell him that I've received the message. It's impossible for me to return the money."

"Alright …" Nereja smiled bitterly. He suddenly thought of something and said, "Right, we had a personnel change not long ago. The original station chief was transferred away, and the deputy station chief took over the space station. I really can't figure out what the higher-ups are thinking, but this is pretty good. The deputy station chief is much better than the original station chief. The station chief found out that I hired you, and he gave me a demerit.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Station chief? I don't have anything against him. He's a good guy, but the deputy station chief is a slippery guy. If he didn't have an ulterior motive, why would he suddenly mention an unresolved internal matter to a mercenary he met for the first time? Plus, the rescued Investigators are all covering for you. Who do you think will tell on you after this? Your opinion of the station chief now represents the effect of the deputy station chief overthrowing him. However, a good guy might not be useful. Even if the deputy station chief had bad intentions, if it weren't for him, your wife and the missing Investigators wouldn't have been saved. From the results, maybe you don't regret being used once. "

In fact, the person who gave out the daily missions to reward the Interstellar Beast Dungeon Crystal was the deputy station chief. He ordered the players to complete some internal matters and quickly accumulated results. If it was the original station chief, he definitely would not have let an outsider interfere with the internal missions.

"Hmm, what you said makes sense. After the station chief was transferred, the deputy station chief seemed very happy."

Sigh, speaking of which, the station chief was only acting according to the rules. Although he was a bit pedantic, he was a military officer after all, so it's understandable. However, I still like the deputy station chief more. If he was so strict about everything, there would only be three Universal Civilizations left in the world now, and they would definitely still be fighting. The other civilizations would either become the vassals of the three or be destroyed by the flames of war … Sigh, between hypocrisy and war, I would choose the former. Maybe most people would choose the same. Although I don't know much about it, I can guess that the Dark Forest period of the exploration era was hell. The peaceful Galaxy Era now is not easy to come by … "

"Okay, okay, you can slowly sigh. I still have something to do. I'm hanging up."

Han Xiao decisively turned off the communication, opened the interface again, and exhaled.

"Let's begin …"

Beep!

At this time, the communicator rang again.

Being interrupted again, Han Xiao was instantly annoyed.

Can't you just let me have a few more draws in peace? The luck that I spent so much effort to gather is about to scatter!

"Who the f * ck is it again … Oh, Ames, hello. Have you eaten? Why are you looking for me?"

The Dragon Emperor's sexy figure appeared on the screen. Han Xiao was a little surprised. Ames had never taken the initiative to contact him before. Why was she suddenly looking for him?

"Black Star, I need you." Ames' expression was a little strange.

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. "Pardon me for asking, but what kind of need are you talking about?"

"I received my teacher's whereabouts. He's come to the Shattered Star Ring. Black Star, you've seen him with your own eyes. Come with me to find him." Ames' tone was firm.

"Okay …" Han Xiao facepalmed. "When?"

"As soon as possible. When I return to the Shattered Star Ring, I'll inform you immediately."

"You're not on Floating Dragon Island now?"

"I'm traveling to the mother planet of the Radiant Federation," Ames said.

Very good, very strong. Han Technician was speechless.

"Okay." Han Xiao was helpless. "Where's your teacher?"

"Someone said that he appeared in Noriose a while ago. Before I come back, you should go there and take a look."

Han Xiao nodded. Although it was a lie that he had seen the Dragon Emperor's teacher before, he did know who the Dragon Emperor's teacher was, so he was not afraid of not recognizing him.

After hanging up, Han Xiao rubbed his temples and opened the interface for the third time.

"Let's draw quickly. I feel like I'm going to lose again … There won't be anyone looking for me this time, right?"

Drawing in progress … Drawing complete.

Your Reward Type is: [Skill]

After taking a look, he chose the most useful option out of the three options. It was a Gunner skill, [Lock-On Shot]. Its effect was that the next shot would definitely hit the target, and there was a 10-18% chance of hitting the target's weak point.

Drawing in progress … Drawing complete.

The Reward Type you obtained this time is: [Item]

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. "Here it comes, here it comes. Chance!"

Please choose one from the three options below.

Esper Ability Awakening Fluid (Deluxe Version): If you have not obtained any main class, there is a chance that you will become an Esper.

Double EXP Card: Double EXP from killing monsters and completing missions. Lasts for 6 days.

"I got two cards, but there's no Mission Completion Card." Han Xiao's chest was tight.

To be honest, the Ability Enhancement Card was useful to him, but Han Xiao was still frustrated that he did not get what he wanted.

Needless to say, the Esper Ability Awakening Fluid was useless, and he did not need the Double EXP Card. Instead, he chose the Ability Enhancement Card.

"My luck is here! Third time! "

Han Xiao's hope was ignited, and he activated a new Random Reward.

Drawing in progress … Drawing complete.

The type of reward you have received this time is [EXP]

"…"

"Good, very good. I lack EXP. Just in time …" Han Xiao clapped, then slammed his head on the table and gritted his teeth. "As if!"

He had always thought that EXP was the most useless reward among all the options.

Drawing in progress … Drawing complete.

The Reward Type you obtained this time is: [Item]

Medium EXP Crystal (x8): Gain a certain amount of EXP after use. Range: 100,000 – 1,000,000

Flaming Sun Battle Rune Halo (Fashion): After wearing it, the body will show a special appearance, and there will be a special light effect when moving. Whether it's strong or not is a matter of the version, but whether it's handsome or not is a matter of a lifetime.

Mission Completion Card (x2): Receive the mission reward with the lowest rating directly. The mission will be considered to have passed.

After letting out a breath, Han Xiao closed his eyes in relief. A sense of satisfaction reverberated in his heart.

"Finally … I finally got it …"

Bang!

The next second, he jumped up like a dead fish and left a palm print on the metal table. He roared at the sky.
